correctness.rationale: Exact height-section count defines the Ehrhart polynomial for all positive cube dimensions. Bernoulli-polynomial coefficient extraction proves equations (3)-(5) for every coefficient, low-index rational bounds establish positivity through d=16, c_17,1=-30301/798 proves first failure, and the Euler-zeta Bernoulli identity yields B_r>r for every r=18,22,..., giving a negative coefficient in every d>=18. The independent standard-library arithmetic reconstruction passes 1249 exact checks for d<=32. No finite experiment is used as proof for the unbounded range.

value.rationale: This is a natural complete classification of the undilated canonical join of two individual Ehrhart-positive lattice building blocks, with an unexpectedly late sharp first failure at cube dimension 17. It provides a negative-coefficient witness for every larger cube dimension, not merely the large-dilation existence already known. The explicit Bernoulli sign mechanism explains a genuine geometric operation boundary and supports further work on positivity stability under joins.
